Welcome to AI Governance Overview. I am Ray Han, Chief AI Trainer at HGT Consultancy. We will define AI governance, examine its scope and components, and compare selected regulatory approaches. We will then use cases to connect governance responsibilities to decisions at work. The final roadmap sets out implementation actions.
